env.name: KNIME_EXECUTION_CSP
env.value: connect-src 'self' http://hub.kbh-troubleshooting.com data:; default-src 'self'; script-src 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline' 'self'; img-src http://storage.hub.kbh-troubleshooting.com 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:;

initContainers.name: wait-for-redis
command: until [ $(wget --server-response http://hub-webapp-redis-master.knime.svc.cluster.local:6379 -O /dev/null 2>&1 | grep -c 'NOAUTH Authentication required') == 1 ]; do echo waiting for redis; sleep 15; done

initContainers.name: wait-for-elasticsearch
command:
while ! curl -vf 'http://knime-hub-endpoint-status-tracker.knime.svc.cluster.local:8080/status?endpoint=elasticsearch-master' | grep -q 'OK'; do echo -e '
waiting...
'; sleep 10; done && echo -e '
now available.'
